h: 我采用了新的 comfyui 模板，分解了子组，添加了 set 和 get 节点来清理它，并在一个地方设置两者共有的所有内容（扩散模型、剪辑、vae、图像大小、正面和负面提示以及种子生成），我还添加了一个图像比较器。希望这可以为一些人节省一些启动和运行新模型的时间。 comfyui 模板的链接和信息仍然在那里。带有原始模板的 github 链接：https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates

o.en: I took the new comfyui template, broke out the subgroups, added set and get nodes to clean it up and have one place to set everything that is common to both (diffusion model, clip, vae, image size, positive and negative prompts, and seed generation), I also added an image comparer. Hopefully this saves some people a little time getting up and running with the new model. The links and information form the comfyui template is still in there. Link to github with original template:https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
